import unittest, tempfile, os
from pathlib import Path
from config import load_config

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_changes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            file=Path(directory)/"config.json"
            other=Path(directory)/"other.json"
            file.write_text('{"value":1}')
            other.write_text('{"value":3}')
            stat=file.stat()
            self.assertEqual(load_config(file)["value"],1)
            file.write_text('{"value":2}')
            os.utime(file,ns=(stat.st_atime_ns,stat.st_mtime_ns))
            self.assertEqual(load_config(file)["value"],2)
            self.assertEqual(load_config(other)["value"],3)
            file.unlink()
            with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):load_config(file)
            file.write_text("invalid")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):load_config(file)
            file.write_text('{"value":4}')
            self.assertEqual(load_config(file)["value"],4)
